desc:
Box for a Lucky Block🥊

How to Play:
🤓 Steal & Box for Loot to get Luckyblocks!
💰 Earn money from your loot!
⬆️ Upgrade your Boxing bag and base
🏃 Punch the Boxing Bag for more POWER!
🥷 Steal other players stuff!
✨ Discover rarer stuff, sizes, and mutations!

🌟 Want to play on your own? Get a free VIP Server!

🎮 Supports Desktop, Console, Mobile, and Tablet players
